allowed_boundaries.rationale: Normalize each declared type once before deriving make, destroy, reuse, and enum helper names.
C local rendering only: id-zero compatibility binders and discard preserve escaped source spelling; nonzero nondiscard binders use projected identity symbols.
Fallback field spelling must agree between C struct declarations and member reads.
Fallback local spelling escapes reserved C identifiers after compiler-local cases.
C derived-symbol rendering only: temporary origins and nonzero anchors use origin/ID keys; an id-zero anchor retains escaped compatibility spelling.
Static record child storage appends an encoded field name to its parent path.
Static closure storage uses the encoded C function name after its private prefix.
Static union child storage encodes the constructor before adding its child index.
Union initializer symbols prefix the encoded variant name.
Union instance symbols prefix the encoded variant name.
Union reuse helper encodes the owning type before the variant suffix.
Union reuse helper encodes the variant after the owning type prefix.

capabilities.rationale: A static source scan cannot prove graph-to-Core definition ID continuity.
These boundaries require output provenance and ABI checks, not path-name guesses.
Duplicate ParsedIdentifier spans require a parsed body, not source text.
Name-to-ID and ID-to-name conversion needs typed call graph evidence.
Identity-bearing string fields beyond exact owner types need typed dataflow review.
Lexical member reads cannot prove the receiver is a CoreVar.
A source scan cannot establish whether repeated records share authority.
Only direct .name equality is recognized; helper predicates need typed review.
Dict[String] and Set[String] syntax does not establish key purpose or semantic use.
Arbitrary String concatenation cannot be distinguished from C symbol assembly lexically.
